lines.text: The psalm calls the servants who stand in the house of the LORD to praise Him because He is good.
The LORD chose Jacob as His own and is above all gods, doing all that pleases Him.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, then struck down Sihon king of the Moabites and Og king of Bashan.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by men's hands, and cannot hear.
The psalm calls the houses of Israel, Aaron and Levi to bless the LORD, who dwells in Bethel.
